dedupe_keys.name: density based clustering algorithm for fault detection and identification in hvac systems

description: Benndorf, Gesa Angelika and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The implemented method uses density-based clustering to detect and identify HVAC operating faults from measurement-like signals. Its demonstration uses a simple simulated system with artificially inserted faults. The publication reports useful detection and diagnostic information but the abstract gives no numeric accuracy, specific clustering settings or publicly available implementation. This model supports diagnosis of the physical HVAC system condition within the tested simulation setting. It is not described as field-validated on a complete occupied building. The distinction between artificial faults and observed operational failures is retained for users assessing model transfer. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; a paper licence does not establish a software licence. Coverage is limited to the stated sites, model settings and application examples. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected. Linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
